No. 2083/14 – THURSDAY, AUGUST, 09, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
(Notice Under Section 7)

My No.:WA/18/09/2013. Land Ministry Ref. No. :4-3/4/2014/D/249. I hereby give notice, under sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, That the government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose:- Description of the Land to be acquired: The allotments of land described below in total extent of 0.0894 Hectare, shown as 1 in the preliminary plan dated 13.06.2018 for Gam 4074 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in village of Palliyawatte, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Wattala in the District of Gampaha, in Western Province and bounded as follows. 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Palliyawatte; Description : Building with Land; Claimant: K.B.L.A. Alwis and K.B.J.P. Jayawardane, No.204, Palliyawatte; Original claimant: -; Extent : 0.0894 Hectare.
All persons interested in the aforesaid land is hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly

authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat Wattala on the 31st Day of October 2018 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 31st Day of October 2018 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
P.D.T.C. RAJIKA, Divisional Secretary , Wattala.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Wattala. 04th August, 2018.

Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired: Preliminary plan No. ya 2902; Village: Chunnakam; G.N. Division: J/198 Chunnakam Town center; D.S. Division: Valikamam south, Uduvil; District: Jaffna; Province: Northern; Purpose: To Establish Chunnakam Police Station. 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Ulakitherapadamum, Aandichchik udijiruppum, Aandiyan Valavum Kudijiruppum, Aandichchi Kudijiruppu Kinattadium Periyapulamum Marupirivukalum; Description : Garden contains one permanent building, one latrine. Two pits and masonry well; Claimant: Appaiah Kunaratnam and wife Uthayakala; Extent : 0.3302 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired, are hereby required to appear personally, or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Valisouth, Uduvil on the 19 th day of September 2018 at 10.00 a.m and are

hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 10th day of September 2018 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
SIVARAJASINGAM JEYAKANTH, Divisional Secretary , Valikamam South, Uduvil.
